projects.title: Network Watch
projects.subtitle: AI-powered transportation network control tower
projects.description: A planner-in-the-loop control tower concept that brings disruption signals, network risk, and rerouting recommendations into one decision workflow. Designed to help planners assess operational impact and act on disruptions.

projects.title: Expansation
projects.subtitle: Network & assortment planner
projects.description: A planning prototype combining capacity constraints, configurable scenarios, and optimization recommendations to support data-driven network and assortment decisions.

projects.title: AI Visa Assistant
projects.subtitle: Conversational AI for Global Mobility
projects.description: An internal AI assistant built around a RAG/NLP approach. I defined the use case and conversation flows, shaped action-oriented document workflows, specified prompt guardrails and fallbacks, and coordinated answer-quality feedback and UAT. Query turnaround reduced from approximately 60 minutes to 15 minutes.

projects.title: GenAI Reporting Assistant
projects.subtitle: Natural-language questions over live data
projects.description: Coordinated delivery of an LLM-based text-to-SQL reporting assistant that lets business users ask questions in natural language, replacing 20–30-minute manual Excel reporting cycles with responses in seconds. Worked through model cost/latency trade-offs and output accuracy checks.

projects.title: DuoSpark
projects.subtitle: Couple experience platform
projects.description: A live customer-facing product prototype with in-app video calling and an option to shop from Amazon. Built using AI-assisted development, from identifying a user need through shipping the experience.

projects.title: Regional Language Smart Ordering Bot
projects.subtitle: Conversational ordering concept
projects.description: A prototype concept for enabling customers to place food orders through a regional-language conversational experience, connecting natural-language interactions with ordering workflows.
